Receptionists try to diagnose you as if they have medical training and tell you what you need.  They are rude and patronising and that's being generous.

To reiterate what was said in another review, you're constantly made to feel as though being ill is simply a nuisance for them!

You have to be cunning and manipulative and know what passwords to use to get past the gatekeeper receptionists, even if you want an appointment for your kids.

There are hardly any doctors or nurses.

Absolute joke.
